sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text: Confidential Information means non-public information disclosed by either party.

sections.heading: Obligations
sections.text: Each party will protect the other's Confidential Information with reasonable care.

sections.heading: Term
sections.text: This agreement runs for two years from the effective date.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of the customer's home state.

sections.heading: Services
sections.text: Vendor will clean the premises five nights a week.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.text: Customer pays a fixed monthly fee, due within 15 days of invoice.

sections.heading: Term and Renewal
sections.text: The term is one year and renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless cancelled 120 days before expiry.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.text: Vendor's total liability is capped at one month of fees.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.text: Either party may terminate for material breach on 30 days notice.

sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text: Losses include any claim arising from the equipment. Customer will indemnify Vendor against all Losses, whatever the cause.

sections.heading: Services
sections.text: Vendor will inspect each elevator monthly.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.text: Fees are due within 30 days of invoice.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.text: Vendor will carry general liability insurance of at least the playbook minimum.

sections.heading: Term
sections.text: The term is three years with no automatic renewal.

sections.heading: Services
sections.text: Vendor will maintain the grounds weekly from April to October.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.text: Fees increase by 8 percent each year.

sections.heading: Assignment
sections.text: Vendor may assign this agreement without Customer's consent.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.text: Customer may terminate for convenience on 60 days notice.

sections.heading: Premises
sections.text: Landlord leases Unit 12 to Tenant.

sections.heading: Rent
sections.text: Base rent is payable monthly in advance.

sections.heading: Operating Costs
sections.text: Tenant pays its share of operating costs with no annual cap.

sections.heading: Repairs
sections.text: Tenant is responsible for all structural repairs.

sections.heading: Indemnity
sections.text: Each party indemnifies the other for its own negligence.

sections.heading: Assignment
sections.text: Tenant may not assign without Landlord's consent, which may be withheld for any reason.

sections.heading: Appendix A: Rules
sections.text: Landlord may change the building rules at any time, and a breach of the rules is a default under the lease.

sections.heading: Services
sections.text: Vendor will patrol the site nightly.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.text: Fees are due within 30 days of invoice.

sections.heading: Data
sections.text: Vendor may keep and reuse camera footage for its own purposes.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.text: Each party's liability is capped at twelve months of fees.
